muted.$description: Tonal buttons and the stepper on cards

mutedForegroundOnTile.$description: Secondary text and icons straight on an accent tile (the shop page's facts, the Category header's count, section footnotes): Muted foreground in light; muted ink, Stone 305, in dark, where the tile is the light pastel (8.84:1 or more)

foregroundOnTile.$description: Text and icons straight on an accent tile: Foreground in light; ink, Stone 150, in dark, where the tile is the light pastel (12.91:1 or more). Text inside a card on the tile stays Foreground

primary.$description: Buttons, the send button, the shopper's bubbles

onPrimaryOnTile.$description: Text and icons on primaryOnTile: white, 8.75:1

tint.$description: Selected tab, links, icons that act

chipSelected.$description: Tonal Indigo selection on controls other than filter chips: the current order step, Android segmented control and snackbar action, the debugger

chipSelectedOnTile.$description: Read in dark only; see chipSelectedRaised (tags.md)

fillRaised.$description: Read in dark only; see tag.fill (tags.md)

fillOnRow.$description: A chip on a row inside the shop page card (What they sell, the rating tags): the Background, 1.21:1 from the white row, no edge, Foreground text 16.3:1 and Muted foreground 6.3:1 (tags.md)

filterSelected.$description: Selected filter chip: Foreground fill, so Indigo means action, not selection (tags.md)

mapRoad.$description: Minor roads and streets on the map

mapBuilding.$description: Buildings on the map: white, shaded by the extrusion light

mapPark.$description: Parks on the map: soft Pistachio

mapWater.$description: Water on the map: a pale cool blue-grey

ground.$description: The map placeholder's ground: the live map's ground, so the cross-fade only adds detail

road.$description: Streets in the map placeholder: the live map's street colour

roadMain.$description: Main roads in the map placeholder: the live map's main-road colour

onLightbox.$description: Count and controls on the photo viewer: 21:1 on Lightbox

success.$description: Check icon on Ready, Paid and Collected (colour.md)

successOnTile.$description: The Open word on an accent tile (the shop page's status line, the Category rows): Success 800 in light, because Success 700 is 4.16:1 on Peach

warningOnTile.$description: The Closes soon word on an accent tile: Warning 800 in light (700 is 4.30:1 on Peach), Foreground in dark

border.$description: A card on a busy area, text fields

separator.$description: 1 px lines between rows, inset to the text

background.$description: The hairline under a top bar on Background: a darker step of the same neutral (1.27:1)

count.$description: The count on the Requests button, Indigo 800 in both modes

glassShine.$description: Web glass: the 0.5 pt inner highlight along the top edge

shadow.$description: Colour of the delicate card shadow

location.$description: The location ask in light mode: the Background, so the quiet street keeps its look (no lift behind the art)

ground1.$description: Page 1, Ask for anything nearby; ink 11.11:1

ground2.$description: Page 2, Snuffle asks the shops; the Peach tile, ink 12.96:1

ground3.$description: Page 3, Buy then collect; the Pistachio tile, ink 13.51:1

chipOn.$description: A selected filter chip's text and edge, on a Card fill: Indigo 800 in light, Indigo 300 in dark (tags.md)

sheetScrim.$description: Foreground at state.sheetScrim behind every sheet (shape.md, Sheets)

glassHairline.$description: Web glass: the 0.5 pt hairline, at state.glassHairline (6%)

grabber.$description: The sheet's grabber: Muted foreground at state.grabber in light; Stone 445 in full in dark (2.49:1), quieter than the title

ground.$description: Splash ground, also the native splash colour; white on it 8.75:1

ink.$description: The mark's face and three stripes on the splash

soft.$description: The mark's two lighter stripes on the splash; 4.94:1 on the ground, 1.8:1 beside white

photoScrim.$description: Opacity of color.photoScrim (black) at the bottom edge of a shop photo

tonalOnTile.$description: Light: white (the per-accent tonal colour) at 55% over the tile

sheetScrim.$description: Opacity of color.sheetScrim behind a sheet at rest (shape.md, Sheets)

askEdge.$description: Opacity of color.askEdge: black at 8% in light

grabber.$description: Opacity of color.grabber: 38% in light (1.72:1 on the sheet), full in dark

selected.$description: Light: a selected filter chip's Indigo 800 edge is 1.5 pt, so it holds against the white unselected chips (tags.md)
